ALGOCOM.title: Receipt is not verification
points: A received payment proof can enable staff verification.
It does not complete that action or satisfy a verified gate.
Service workflows are distinct from stored research records.

ALGOCOM.title: A precise graph model
points: Inputs: DAG G=(V,E), completed C, requirements R, evidence B, durations d.
Ready(v): every prerequisite completed AND every evidence gate satisfied.
Output: readiness reasons, earliest finishes, longest duration and path.

ALGOCOM.title: The objective is structural duration
points: r(v)=0 for completed steps; otherwise r(v)=d(v).
F(v)=r(v)+max predecessor F; an empty maximum is zero.
T=max F(v): unlimited parallel capacity; staffing and evidence waits excluded.

ALGOCOM.title: Why dynamic programming fits
points: Evaluate shared prerequisite subproblems once in topological order.
Joins take the maximum finish, not the sum of parallel branches.
Keep one maximizing parent to recover a path certificate.

ALGOCOM.title: Walk through the certificate
points: S4 completed → S5 verification (15 min) → S6 processing (45 min).
Received proof makes S5 ready; S6 is blocked until S5 completes.
F={0,15,60}; critical path [S5,S6]; estimate 60 min.

ALGOCOM.title: Correctness depends on invariants
points: Queue indegree equals the count of unprocessed prerequisites.
Induction: every predecessor finish is final before a step is evaluated.
Backtracking actual maximizing edges certifies the reported longest path.

ALGOCOM.title: Growth is linear in the full input
points: Proposed: O(V+E+Q+B) under expected constant-time hashing.
Repeated scans: O(V(V+E)+Q+B) upper bound; ordered cases can be linear.
Storage includes graph, normalized evidence and output—not just the queue.

ALGOCOM.title: Measured comparison: 1,000-step cases
points: Median milliseconds; ten warmed repetitions; same synthetic input per pair.
Timing and memory were measured separately. Speedups are machine/input dependent.

ALGOCOM.title: Keep the computation outside the web thread
points: Staff client → Express auth / bounded admission → Python child → pure solver
Express → PostgreSQL identities and records; Python receives no DB credentials.
2 workers | 5 s timeout | 2 MiB body | 5,000 steps | 25,000 edges
